role_ru: Вход в личный смысл: пользователь должен почувствовать, что это не generic motivation и не жесткое предсказание.
user_goal_ru: Recognize why today matters without deterministic or clinical overclaim.
prototype_copy: Today is for turning one real feeling into one small proof. Pick the theme that feels alive right now.
user_action_ru: Choose one theme: courage, repair, clarity, softness, momentum.
expected_signal_ru: Participant can explain why this is personal rather than generic content.
failure_signal_ru: Participant reads it as vague astrology, generic motivation, or unsafe certainty.
test_question_ru: Narrate what you think is happening on this screen.
decision_use_ru: Экран можно оставлять в MVP только если он помогает пройти двухминутную петлю быстрее и понятнее.
claim_boundary_ru: Это stimulus card, не результат пользовательской валидации. Claim можно усиливать только после заполненных prototype_session_capture_sheet и scorecard.

role_ru: Минимальный контекст: петля получает живую точку дня, но не превращается в длинный onboarding.
user_goal_ru: Give the loop enough context to avoid generic advice.
prototype_copy: One sentence only: what do you want to feel different by tonight?
user_action_ru: Type or speak one short sentence.
expected_signal_ru: Participant supplies a concrete lived moment or emotional target.
failure_signal_ru: Participant skips because the prompt feels too broad, exposing, or irrelevant.

role_ru: Перевод смысла в действие: центральная проверка, что Alina не остается чтением или дневником.
user_goal_ru: Convert meaning into a concrete action small enough to finish now.
prototype_copy: Your action: send one honest message, tidy one visible surface, or take a two-minute walk. Pick the one that proves your theme.
user_action_ru: Pick one action and mark intent.
expected_signal_ru: Participant sees the action as doable and causally linked to the chosen theme.
failure_signal_ru: Participant sees it as a random task, chore list, or generic habit tracker.
test_question_ru: Narrate what you think is happening on this screen.
decision_use_ru: Если действие читается как случайная задача, Alina должна менять механику action selection до следующего теста.

failure_signal_ru: Participant thinks the reset is filler or clashes with the progress mechanic.

user_action_ru: Tap Done and select one felt-state tag.

failure_signal_ru: Participant wants objective tracking, rejects proof language, or feels judged.
